# Vendored tree-sitter Rocq parser

`src/parser.c.gz` and `src/tree_sitter/parser.h` are generated grammar assets
from `aruzdh/tree-sitter-rocq` revision
`300fe33fc299c30f736fd56d8ef8a28b08acd4e6` with
`meta-language-tactics.patch` applied, regenerated by tree-sitter CLI 0.25.10.
The upstream Cargo manifest declares the grammar as MIT licensed.

The patch adds constructs that Rocq programs emitted by the translator use and
the upstream grammar reports as errors: Recdef's `Function` command, mutually
recursive (`Ltac a := ... with b := ...`) and redefining (`Ltac a ::= ...`)
Ltac definitions, the `first [ ... ]` and `solve [ ... ]` tacticals, and Ltac
`let x := ... in ...`. It also adds `test/corpus/meta_language.txt`; upstream's
test corpus and the new cases pass with the patch.
`node js/scripts/build-vendored-grammars.mjs --only rocq` reapplies it and
requires the regenerated parser to equal `src/parser.c.gz`.

The uncompressed `parser.c` SHA-256 is
`f2296d1c1938530a2abf8fd650a72bea31ee68af31dc11035379cfa96eae5f45`.
The `parser.h` SHA-256 is
`180b893c8734778fd32f372dfbc27bd6ad1cd2221f26150b31256ff6716320d2`.

The generated C source is stored deterministically compressed to keep every
checked-in source file below the repository's 1,000-line limit. `build.rs`
expands it into Cargo's output directory before compilation.
